sources.title: [FIXTURE] Automated Jailbreak via PAIR: 88% ASR on GPT-4
sources.understanding_summary: PAIR is an automated algorithm that achieves 88% success rate jailbreaking GPT-4 with fewer than 20 queries in black-box settings, and existing input-filtering defenses only reduce success to 34%.
